## 1. Professional Overview

Karthick A is an AI Engineer and Full-Stack Developer with a completed Bachelor of Science (BSc) degree in Computer Science from A M Jain College in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. 

His engineering work focuses on solving real-world challenges at the intersection of generative artificial intelligence and high-reliability software engineering. Rather than treating machine learning as purely academic experiments, Karthick specializes in building production-ready systems: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that eliminate hallucinations with mathematical vector precision, fine-tuning large language models using parameter-efficient methods (QLoRA) on modern open-weights architectures, and developing live voice-enabled AI agents (such as Sana) with multi-turn memory and low-latency speech synthesis.

## 3. Comprehensive Technical Skill Matrix

### 3.1 Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**:
  - Document chunking, recursive text splitting, semantic boundary detection
  - Dense embedding generation using state-of-the-art embedding models
  - Vector similarity search (Cosine similarity, Dot product, Euclidean distance)
  - Hybrid search: Combining sparse keyword BM25 with dense vector embeddings
  - Context reranking and source citation validation to eradicate hallucinations
- **Large Language Models & Fine-Tuning**:
  - Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT): LoRA, QLoRA (4-bit / 8-bit quantization via bitsandbytes)
  - Open model architectures: Qwen (Qwen 2.5, Qwen 9B), Llama 3/3.1, Mistral
  - Dataset preparation: Instruction tuning dataset curation, synthetic data generation, filtering, tokenization
  - Evaluation: Perplexity tracking, loss curves, benchmark evaluation suites
- **Agentic Workflows & Tool Calling**:
  - Model Context Protocol (MCP) server & client architectures
  - Function calling / Structured Outputs using Pydantic schemas
  - Multi-agent coordination and recursive task decomposition
  - Automated workflow pipelines via n8n and Python scripts
- **Audio & Multimodal AI**:
  - ElevenLabs text-to-speech API integration with custom voice personas
  - OpenAI Whisper for speech recognition and transcription

### 3.2 Backend & Distributed Systems
- **Primary Language**: Python (asyncio, high-concurrency patterns, type annotations)
- **Frameworks**: FastAPI, Pydantic, Starlette, Uvicorn
- **Alternative Frameworks**: Node.js, Express

## 4. Key Projects & Technical Case Studies

### 4.1 RAG Knowledge Engine
- **Type**: Generative AI Enterprise System
- **Repository**: https://github.com/akarthick-dev
- **Core Problem**: Traditional LLM responses suffer from factual hallucinations and outdated knowledge when answering enterprise domain queries.
- **Solution**: Developed an end-to-end RAG architecture that ingests unstructured enterprise documents, divides them into context-aware chunks, creates vector embeddings, and indexes them in a Supabase pgvector store. When queries arrive, hybrid retrieval fetches the top-k most relevant excerpts, applies reranking, and constructs a grounded prompt with explicit source citation markers.
- **Technologies**: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, Supabase (pgvector), LangChain, Vector Embeddings.

### 4.2 Sana — Live AI Companion Product
- **Type**: Applied AI & Voice Agent Application
- **Live URL**: https://sana.karthicka.me
- **Core Problem**: Standard conversational bots feel robotic, stateless, and forget context quickly across multi-turn sessions.
- **Solution**: Engineered Sana, a personalized AI companion that retains conversation memory across sessions, maintains a consistent persona, and replies using low-latency, emotionally expressive voice synthesis via ElevenLabs.
- **Technologies**: Python, LLM APIs, Advanced Prompt Orchestration, Memory Buffering, ElevenLabs Speech Synthesis, Fast API service.

### 4.3 Qwen 9B Model Fine-Tune
- **Type**: Open-Weights LLM Fine-Tuning & Evaluation
- **Repository**: https://github.com/akarthick-dev
- **Core Problem**: Off-the-shelf generalist models often perform sub-optimally on domain-specific prompt response tasks or require expensive parameter retraining.
- **Solution**: Fine-tuned a Qwen 9B base model utilizing Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) with 4-bit precision to fit within consumer and mid-tier GPU constraints. Built automated scripts for data cleaning, prompt-response formatting, loss metric monitoring, and comparative evaluation against baseline checkpoints.
- **Technologies**: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, QLoRA, bitsandbytes, Linux GPU environment.
